newsitem.title: PERU: Peruvian police release two arrested reporters.
newsitem.headline: Peruvian police release two arrested reporters.

text.p: Peruvian police on Saturday released two employees of Japanese television station TV Asahi who were arrested on Tuesday after meeting Marxist rebels holding 74 hostages in the besieged residence of the Japanese ambassador in Lima, a TV Asahi official said.
"They have been released," the official told a news conference, referring to TV Asahi reporter Tsuyoshi Hitomi and his Peruvian interpreter Victor Borja.
Hitomi would leave Peru later on Saturday on a flight to New York, where he is based, the official said.
The Peruvian and Japanese governments had criticised the two men for sneaking into the residence to meet the rebels, saying they had jeopardised efforts to end the 25-day-old stand-off.
